description: Realistic distribution-transformer parameters for snapping (filling missing values). First dataset is Energex/Ergon (Queensland) oriented. Percentage impedance and X/R are rating-dependent (and largely HV-class independent across 11/22/33 kV); no-load loss and magnetising current fall with rating per the AS 2374.1.2 / AS 60076.11 MEPS regime.
sources: Horizon Power, Specification - Distribution Transformers (Z% ladder 3.3/4.0/6.0%, vector group Dyn1, taps +10/-5% in 2.5% steps; close WA analogue to Energex/Ergon)
AS 2374.1.2-2003 (R2025) MEPS / AS 60076.11 (no-load & load loss regime, 10-2500 kVA, <=24 kV)
Ergon Energy JTS02-03-01 (QLD distribution transformer standard)
IEEE Std 242 / ANSI C57.12 (X/R guidance rising with rating)
notes: z_pct is the percentage short-circuit impedance on the unit's own rating base; percentage impedance is base-invariant, so it applies referred to either side.
xr_ratio splits z_pct into resistance and reactance: x_pct = z_pct*xr/sqrt(1+xr^2), r_pct = z_pct/sqrt(1+xr^2).

g_no_load_pct is core (iron) loss as a percent of rated VA; mag_current_pct is the no-load magnetising current as a percent of rated current. Both are MEPS-consistent typicals and should be verified against purchased AS 2374.1.2 tables / actual Energex spec sheets before use in loss-critical studies.
vector_group is informational for the two-winding subtypes (the subtype already encodes wye/delta); it is not written into the schema-constrained transformer dict.
Matching is primarily on (subtype, rated power); v_from_class / v_to_class document the covered voltage envelope and gate implausible matches.
